text.p: An official at SGS-Thomson said the semiconductor group expected its gross margin to rise toward 40 percent in the fourth quarter and said 1998 would probably be an excellent year due to an industry recovery.
"We have always said that in a good period, the gross margin will be between 40 and 42 percent. In the fourth quarter, we'll be going towards that," said the company official.
SGS-Thomson reported earlier that its gross margin was 38.2 percent in the first quarter and 38.5 percent in the second.
The official said, "1998 should be an excellent year. All the signs are there." The company sees the semiconductor industry recovering in the fourth quarter.
